title: Penthouse Magazine July 2002 Nadia Vasi Vintage
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, July 2002 issue, cover and centerfold Nadia Vasi (Penthouse Pet of the Month). Features an interview with Lee Ann Womack, plus culture content ("Box-Lunch Special," Hepatitis C feature, "American Tragedy," Kyle Turley interview).
Complete issue, no missing pages noted. Ships discreetly in a plain wrapper/sleeve.
Adult content — buyer must be 18+.
